mali_full_features_graph.claim_boundary: Pinned upstream 51-global extractor and graph/global/fusion architecture ported to pinned compiled/physical views; not source-native logical-input reproduction or paper-split replication.

mali_full_features_mlp.claim_boundary: Upstream global-only model option with the same 51-global raw schema, fitting partitions, preprocessing, objective, optimizer, epoch selection and seeds as the full-feature graph.

source.read_policy: Read pinned git blobs, not a possibly modified working-tree helper/model. Port import and API compatibility explicitly; no IBM credential or live-provider import side effect.

existing_reusable_transform_reference.scope: Train-only statistics/zero-variance handling reference, not the 340-only runner or its generated validation assignment.

qonductor_archive.retrieval: Use the pinned Qonductor dataset/source closure in qonductor_native_features.json; verify archive and each canonical member digest. This contract does not bundle the external archive.

dataset.route: For Ma-Li340 and QPack3945, load the saved compiled_qasm3_file and verify compiled_qasm3_sha256 relative to compiled_unified, then apply allocated-wire restoration. Qonductor4482 has no saved compiled_qasm3_file: load the exact circuits.zip member referenced by canonical qasm_path_or_member and verify qasm_bytes_sha256; use pinned upstream QASM2-then-QASM3 parsing. Never regenerate/transpile a replacement circuit.

physical_wire_restoration.problem: Saved hardware-QASM3 uses $N operands and omits trailing idle allocation. The audited importer preserves N but allocates only max referenced N+1. An inspected QPack register-width7 row using $0/$1 imports as two qubits, changing Ma-Li allocated-width metrics. A sparse $0/$6 fixture retains index6; do not claim arbitrary index compression.
physical_wire_restoration.adapter: Parse QASM3 AST; prepend a uniquely named quantum register of pinned representation_rows.register_width and replace each hardware Identifier('$N') with that register[N]. Preserve classical declarations and operation/condition structure. Do not use textual replacement, transpile, generate gates, reindex physical N or drop unused wires.
physical_wire_restoration.scope: Saved compiled Ma-Li/QPack hardware-QASM3 only. Submitted Qonductor archive inputs retain original parsing/declarations; do not infer an extra allocation from backend capacity.
physical_wire_restoration.validation: Every N must be integer in [0, register_width); restored qc.num_qubits must equal pinned register_width and global qc.find_bit qarg positions must equal original physical N. Named-register forms must be validated against the same wire map rather than padded by guesswork.
physical_wire_restoration.failure: Unavailable_physical_wire_restoration_mismatch with exact expected/observed signature and reason; never continue with compressed width or misassigned T1/T2.
physical_wire_restoration.feature_signature_gate: Before feature extraction require parity of allocated quantum width, classical width, operation name/arity/order, physical qarg and carg identities, directive/condition semantics, operation counts and saved directed operation-DAG dependencies against pinned compiled IR/graph evidence. Preserve original record-to-node correspondence. Neither digest mismatch alone nor count-only equality is sufficient.
physical_wire_restoration.allowed_ir_digest_difference: Round-trip global phase and numeric angle representation may change the full compiler digest without changing these declared features. Accept only explicitly documented differences limited to phase/parameters omitted by BOTH 51-global and178-node encoders, with the full feature-signature gate passing; never extend this exception to gates/wires/depth/conditions or parameter-dependent structure.

source_stages.mali_real_qpu: Exact original logical QASM already deterministically transpiled to pinned nominal target; extract from the pinned compiled result, not original logical QASM in this method.
source_stages.qonductor_single_circuit_ibm: Exact submitted physical QASM from the pinned circuits.zip archive member, with canonical per-member byte hash; no saved compiled QASM3 or new transpilation is assumed.
source_stages.qpack_mcp: Six angle-insensitive representative QAOA structural reconstructions transpiled to nominal target; reconstruction-qualified, not exact submitted angles/routing.

dataset.source_stage_recording: Record source identity and actual feature/graph stage separately; legacy lifecycle_stage describes source provenance and must not relabel this model's physical input as logical.
dataset.shots: Not an original model feature or normalization target. Train directly against recorded mixed-shot service seconds; report shot strata. No division by 1024 or multiplication by query shots. A 51+shots model requires its own contract and fits.

global_features.extractor: helper.create_feature_dict and utils.calc_supermarq_features from pinned blobs, API port with parity fixtures
global_features.input_stage: Pinned circuit BEFORE graph-specific RemoveBarriers and RemoveFinalMeasurements; do not reuse seven-global summary fields as substitutes.
global_features.count_rule: 44 exact operation-name counts in dictionary order; absent named operation zero; no gate-equivalence pooling. Global count SWAP means literal swap, unlike Qonductor's field of that name.
global_features.num_qubits: qc.num_qubits allocated register width, not active width and not qc.width including classical bits
global_features.depth: qc.depth() unfiltered, including measurement according to pinned compatible Qiskit semantics

metric_symbols.G: sum(qc.count_ops().values()) minus barrier and measure counts
metric_symbols.D: qc.depth filtered to names other than barrier and measure
metric_symbols.D_multi: qc.depth filtered to qarg arity >1 and name != barrier
metric_symbols.A: sum(len(qargs)) over instructions excluding barrier and measure
metric_symbols.C: sum of distinct connectivity neighbor counts; add both endpoints only for exactly-two-qarg operations. Higher arity operations do not generate all-pairs links.

global_features.degenerate_policy: n<=1 or G<=0 or D<=0 yields unavailable_degenerate_upstream_metric; no invented epsilon or undefined value set to zero. Each metric must be finite and within [0,1], and M<=G; exact violations are unavailable_upstream_metric_range, not clipping.
global_features.dead_helper: circ_dag_converter.get_global_features allocates only six fields and is not the 51-feature helper. Do not use it as this contract's extractor.

graph.builder: Pinned circ_dag_converter.circ_to_dag_with_data conventions with explicit offline API adapter
graph.node_order: Pinned upstream DAG insertion enumeration, not a new topological positional encoding. Record adapter enumeration and golden parity on fixtures.

node_fields.meaning: in,out then 44 gate names in global dictionary order
first-encounter compact used-wire index one/two-hot; not raw physical-index one-hot

graph.wire_mapping: Use global qc.find_bit wire indices to map physical circuit wires to snapshot qubits, then upstream first-encounter compact remapping for the 127-hot representation. Multiple registers cannot use ambiguous private register-local _index; document this compatibility correction.
graph.pruning: Remove barriers and final measurements before DAG creation; retain in/out nodes for used quantum wires; remove idle quantum wire in/out pairs. Reject remaining mid-circuit measurement/classical nodes/conditions rather than dropping dynamic semantics.
graph.edge_rule: Directed upstream DAG dependencies; collapse multiple wire edges between same pair into a simple DiGraph. No reversed, undirected, self-added or branch edges. Preserve valid node correspondence without string-label/integer collisions.

padding_quirks_preserved.in_out: Set compact wire-hot and first T1/T2 pair, second pair zero.
padding_quirks_preserved.one_operand_operation: Set gate type and index only. Upstream else branch fills wire/T1T2 ONLY if len(qargs)==2; one-qubit op wire and T1T2 remain zero.
padding_quirks_preserved.two_operand_operation: Set both compact wire positions and two T1/T2 pairs in qarg order.
padding_quirks_preserved.higher_operand_named_operation: Upstream known gate type and index remain set, but wire/T1T2 slots zero, exactly as one-operand case. Record this lossy quirk; never silently introduce a third-qubit encoding.

graph.gate_error: use_gate_error exists in default YAML but model/node builder do not encode numerical gate errors; noise_dict gate entries equal 1 and are not input features. Do not add gate-duration/error slots under an original label.
graph.unsupported_operations: Any post-pruning name absent from 44-gate dictionary, control-flow block/condition, remaining measure/reset/delay/store or nonquantum node yields graph unavailable with actual name/reason; missing information is not an all-zero gate type.

recorded_inventory.meaning: Read-only saved-count support inventory, not successful materialization/CUDA training. ECR is explicitly in upstream dictionary. No prepromised 8766 successful graph predictions.

calibration.selection: Same backend and snapshot ID/properties SHA already pinned in representation_rows plus snapshot_registry. No test-error selection, live calls or later replacement by a nicer snapshot.
calibration.properties_resolution: Resolve registry properties_path by portable content SHA; preserve a local resolution map. Verify each raw JSON hash against target_properties_sha256 before extraction.
calibration.units: Convert T1/T2 property values with explicitly parsed units to microseconds; record both original unit/value and canonical numeric microseconds. Upstream reads raw property value and common IBM snapshots use us, so canonicalization is disclosed and us fixtures must be exactly unchanged.
calibration.validity: Each quantum wire needed by graph must exist in same-backend snapshot and contain finite positive T1 and T2. Missing/nonfinite/invalid-unit property yields graph unavailable_missing_backend_property. Never copy another wire/backend, fill zero, use backend means or predict properties.
calibration.mlp_policy: Global-only MLP does not need node calibration. A graph-specific calibration/resource failure must not fabricate a failure for an otherwise valid MLP; retain individual availability and compare their actual successful intersection. Common global/dynamic failures affect both.

architecture.transformer_convs: 178->178, 178->178, 178->178 TransformerConv, source/default heads=1, concat=true, dropout=0, no edge features, source/default root_weight and bias; ReLU after each
architecture.global_branch: retained-global-width ->64->64 with ReLU after each layer
architecture.graph_fusion_head: concat178+64=242 ->512->512->128->1; ReLU after first three linear layers; final output unconstrained
architecture.mlp_head: retained-global-width ->64->64->512->512->128->1; ReLU after all except final output
architecture.no_substitution: No 64-wide graph layers, seven globals, log target, GAT/GRU replacement, hidden shots or source/backend embedding.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Only eligible fit rows inside frozen outer-train with inner_fold!=0. Never outer-test or inner-validation.
preprocessing.global_mask: Retain raw field if sum over fit rows >0, exactly upstream refine_training_data policy; log raw 51-field order and retained index list per fold. Do not infer a mask from all corpus.
preprocessing.global_statistics: One observation weight per fit row; unbiased sample mean/std in float64, transformed storage float32.
preprocessing.node_statistics: Pool all nodes in fit graphs, node-weighted; stable streaming float64 mean/unbiased sample std without concatenating giant graphs.
preprocessing.zero_variance_policy: std<=1e-6 => transformed column zero in fit/validation/test; otherwise (value-fit_mean)/fit_std. Disclosed correction to upstream std+1e-8 instability; no test-based fallback scaling.
preprocessing.heldout_labels: Separate scoring ledger; held-out graph.y sentinel zero and inference takes no labels. No preprocessing, node order or property selection consumes labels.
preprocessing.transform_pins: Persist fit row IDs/hash, retained columns, means/stds/variable masks, node counts, protocol/input hashes; seeds share a deterministic fold transform.

training.cell_product: two methods x five outer folds x three seeds =30 complete neural fits
training.fit_valid_test: For outer f: test is frozen outer_fold=f; select inner manifest rows whose outer_fold=f, restricted to outer-train. Validation inner_fold=0, fit inner_fold in {1,2,3}. The matched graph and MLP use identical fit/validation identities from common successfully materialized global+node inputs; log any feature/calibration-ineligible training identities for both. Resource failures cannot shrink this common fitting set. MLP inference may also predict additional test rows with valid globals but graph-specific unavailable inputs, retaining separate coverage. Assert exact unified_leakage_group_id disjointness and complete matching canonical identities.
training.model_selection: Hyperparameters fixed to pinned default YAML; no HPO and no outer-test tuning. Train 500 epochs; save epoch minimizing inner-validation raw-seconds MSE (earliest on exact tie). Evaluate test once with that best checkpoint. No early termination on score and no all-outer-train refit.
training.loss: unweighted mean squared error on raw observed seconds
training.initialization: Reset Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA RNG for each seed before model construction; deterministic seeded epoch permutations shared by both variants. Record framework deterministic capability and any nondeterministic kernels rather than claiming bitwise CUDA reproducibility.
training.prediction_policy: Keep unconstrained raw-seconds model output, including finite negative output, for primary scoring; count negative predictions. No undeclared clipping, log inverse or per-source calibrator.
training.seed_reduction: Row-wise median of all three required seed predictions; preserve per-seed outputs/dispersion. An incomplete seed set is partial, not a three-seed result.
training.execution_device: CUDA mandatory for both neural variants; CPU analytical/classical regression is unaffected
training.checkpoint: Atomic latest every <=10 epochs with model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG, epoch/next position, best validation state, transform, seed/fold/method and code/data/protocol hashes; validate identities before resume.

resource_policy.microbatch: Split an effective batch of two into microbatches/singletons as necessary; accumulate summed per-observation losses divided by actual effective batch size, then one optimizer step. Last odd batch uses its actual size. Never change sample weighting or drop a giant graph.

activation_recomputation.operation: torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint over each complete TransformerConv+ReLU layer; use_reentrant=False, preserve_rng_state=True. No checkpointing that replaces a layer, changes graph edges/input/node178/precision or samples nodes.
activation_recomputation.mode_selection: On the predeclared largest complete-graph CUDA resource canary, try no recomputation first. If it violates the pinned resource budget, try layer recomputation. Selection uses resource feasibility only, never validation/test scores; freeze selected mode for all graph fitting cells and record it in each checkpoint/cell manifest.
activation_recomputation.gradient_parity_gate: C4: in float32 compare outputs, summed loss, parameter gradients and one Adam step between recomputation-disabled and enabled on identical fixture/model/RNG/effective batch. Require torch.allclose rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6 with identical finite masks. Preserve RNG and deterministic capability records; failed parity is a technical blocker, not permission to relax tolerances silently.
activation_recomputation.inference: Record the selected fitting mode; ordinary eval/no_grad inference does not need activation recomputation and must preserve identical outputs. Recomputation changes training compute cost only; no training/inference cost is substituted for the archived runtime target.
activation_recomputation.failure: If intact singleton remains infeasible with validated recomputation, retain the whole-cell fit resource_failure rule; do not downgrade178 architecture to64, truncate, drop or approximate a graph.

resource_policy.giant_graphs: A graph over node budget runs alone; no truncation/subsampling/partial neighborhoods. Raw 178-float features already require about1GiB for1.43M operations before in/out nodes, edges and activations. Finite CUDA canary on largest graph is required; resource failure is explicit, not assumed success from free VRAM.
resource_policy.fit_resource_failure: If a required eligible fit graph cannot be processed intact under pinned resources after declared singleton policy, mark entire method/fold/seed terminal resource_failure. Do not remove it from training silently. OOF inference-only resource failures are per-row and retain denominator.
resource_policy.timeouts: No scientific per-graph training timeout. Worker heartbeat/checkpoint stall detection diagnoses failure but is not permission to discard slow rows. Changing resources/batch/epochs requires recorded contract amendment.
resource_policy.exclusive_timing: No simulator timing concurrent with any training or heavy extraction. No new simulator measurements/live QPU under this contract.

before_execution: all pinned source/assets hashes match and same 8767 canonical IDs/targets/outer assignments are retained
golden 51-field order/metric parity for one-qubit degenerate, empty, barrier/final measurement, CX/ECR, and known three-qubit gate fixtures
golden178-node graph fixture for in/out, one/two/higher operand padding, directed duplicate edges and multiple registers
source/backend canaries verify exact QASM and snapshot properties hashes, unit conversion and fail-closed unknown cases
train-only transform regression injects held-out perturbations without changing fitted statistics/mask
rawseconds loss/optimizer/global-only architecture parity and microbatch weighted-gradient equivalence
CUDA finite forward/backward including giant graph or explicit whole-cell resource-failure disposition
atomic resume equivalence and no held-out label access
acceptance.execution_sequence_if_later_authorized: Materialize all8767 row-status attempts first; then fold0 x three seeds x both methods; automatic remaining folds only after technical QA. Low validation/test accuracy is not failure of gate.

evaluation.log_metric_policy: Optional log error only on declared valid-domain rows and explicit metric denominator; raw negative predictions cannot be silently log-transformed/clipped.
evaluation.paired: Hash common successful test-row identities for every comparison; never compare different denominators as a ranking.
evaluation.summaries: Pooled and source-stratified metrics with equal-source macro; source-stratified leakage-group paired bootstrap, frozen bootstrap registry stream. Preserve raw OOF labels/predictions/seed reduction provenance.
evaluation.ablation_boundary: Existing seven-global compiled model differs in node widths, architecture, target and schedule; comparing it with this run is descriptive, not a causal seven-versus51 feature ablation.

fidelity_deviations: Unified8677 sources rather than author340 QPU subset; common compiled/physical views rather than original logical graphs
Reconstruction-qualified QPack structures rather than recovered submitted angles
Backend-matched nominal offline snapshots and canonical microsecond values rather than exact historical live calibration
Frozen grouped outer/inner benchmark splits and three seeds instead of author random8:1:1 and seed1234
Fit-only normalization/pruning and zero-variance centering replace whole-dataset preprocessing and epsilon amplification
Global wire resolution/portable Qiskit API import adapters repair version/private-index assumptions, without changing declared feature meaning
CUDA instead of defaultconfig CPU; resource-safe exact gradient microbatching may replace materialized batch2
Selected best inner-validation weights loaded explicitly; upstream trainer's commented model save/stale-file test behavior is not reproduced
Full51 raw input is retained as declared even though train-only positive-sum mask can reduce effective per-fold width
Original one/higher-operand metadata padding and absence of shots/gateerror feature are preserved and disclosed, not silently corrected

outputs.checkpoint_publication: Optional content-hash-pinned external assets; exclude caches/canary/polling scratch from public allowlist.
